notes.title: Drop Pockets 0.76.91 hotfix
notes.notes:
Fixed Oba Doba's heck invaders not moving toward camp
Fixed the ability to delete stash balls
Fixed Pren unlocking a duplicate shark

On Windows, changed the process name to properly display the game's title

notes.title: Demo hotfix: 0.74.46
notes.notes: Fixed an issue where selling an equipped cue would crash the game

notes.title: Demo hotfix: 0.74.45
notes.notes: Fixed slime ball info menu displaying incorrect info

notes.title: Demo hotfix 0.74.43
notes.notes:
Fixed an issue where pockets would not purchase

Fixed an issue where the pocket tooltips did not reset 

Fixed the tooltip for big and small slime balls

Wishing well pocket can no longer target the cue ball

notes.title: Demo hotfix: 0.74.42
notes.notes:
Fixed the ball info menu not properly displaying the echoed effect

Fixed an issue where text in the stash menu did not appear

Fixed an issue where balls would be pulled into a magnetic pocket when in a bear trap

Fixed pocket tooltips not displaying the correct effects

Fixed an issue where some items in the shop would take cash but not purchase

Fixed a rare issue where the game would not end if an 8 ball sinks during the transition to shark phase
